purpose: .fft weights its samples with the symmetric Kaiser window (WINDOW=KAISER ALFA=3), whose edge samples reach 1/I0(pi ALFA).

oracle.derivation: Exact DFT of the samples of 0.5 sin(2 pi 2k t) on [1 ms, 5 ms), NP = 256, weighted by the standard symmetric Kaiser window w[n] = I0(pi ALFA sqrt(1 - (2n/(NP-1) - 1)^2)) / I0(pi ALFA) with ALFA = 3 (Harris 1978), 2/sum(w) scaling, cosine-referenced phase. HSPICE's FFT phase is cosine-referenced (Star-Hspice 1998.2 ch. 25 Example 1: a sine at a whole-cycle window start reads -90 deg), as in the HSPICE deck; ESPice reads .fft as HSPICE's in either dialect, normalized to the peak bin.
